title: Bug: snmp/test_snmp_phy_entity.py::test_fabric_card_info fails due to mismatch in SNMP info and STATE_DB
author: vishal-nokia
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

PR [#601](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-platform-daemons/pull/601) modified `chassisd` to add Fabric card module information to `PHYSICAL_ENTITY_INFO` table in `STATE_DB`. That includes modules which are not present.

This leads to failure of the following test case:
`snmp/test_snmp_phy_entity.py::test_fabric_card_info`

The test case using SNMP queries the EntPhysicalTable  which returns only the present entries.  The test case compares the SNMP returned entries to the entries which are added to the STATE_DB. Since the STATE_DB also contains non-present modules, the test case fails.

```
$ snmpwalk -v 2c -c public 100.117.29.8 .1.3.6.1.2.1.47.1.1.1.1.2 | grep FABRIC-CARD
iso.3.6.1.2.1.47.1.1.1.1.2.711000000 = STRING: "FABRIC-CARD2"
iso.3.6.1.2.1.47.1.1.1.1.2.714000000 = STRING: "FABRIC-CARD5"
```
```
admin@ixre-cpm-chassis9:~$ sonic-db-cli STATE_DB keys "PHYSICAL_ENTITY_INFO|FABRIC*"
PHYSICAL_ENTITY_INFO|FABRIC-CARD2
PHYSICAL_ENTITY_INFO|FABRIC-CARD5
PHYSICAL_ENTITY_INFO|FABRIC-CARD0
PHYSICAL_ENTITY_INFO|FABRIC-CARD4
PHYSICAL_ENTITY_INFO|FABRIC-CARD3
PHYSICAL_ENTITY_INFO|FABRIC-CARD1
PHYSICAL_ENTITY_INFO|FABRIC-CARD7
PHYSICAL_ENTITY_INFO|FABRIC-CARD6
``` 

### Steps to Reproduce

Load master image on SUPERVISOR card that does not have all fabric cards present.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual Behavior:
SNMP entries do not match with entries in `PHYSICAL_ENTITY_INFO` table.
Expected Behavior:
SNMP entries should match with entries in `PHYSICAL_ENTITY_INFO` table.
